turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a written explanation of why Owen learned about it from his phone before anyone called me. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and an answer on why nobody called before the mark went in. The fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got to it; her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you ended before you said anything to her.
What cost ground: Nothing, though stopping right after her opening question left her demand unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. You showed no evidence, so you came nowhere near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Answer her opening question with one sentence owning that the zero went in before you called, then put a dated document in front of her.
